Download a file from datalibweb as is

Source: R/dlw_get_data.R
dlw_download_file.Rd

Downloads any file (data, programs, documents) without reading or pinning it. Use [dlw_get_data] to read data files.

Usage

dlw_download_file(
  country_code,
  filename,
  server = NULL,
  path = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

country_code

character: ISO3 code

filename

character: Name of the file to save/read (required)

server

character: in case we have more than one server. default is GMD

path

character: where to save the file. If a directory, the file is saved in it with the name given by the API. If `NULL` (default), the file is not saved but returned as raw bytes.

overwrite

logical: whether to replace an existing file at `path`. Default is FALSE.

...

additional request arguments (e.g., `year`, which is required, `vermast`, `veralt`, `collection`), as in [dlw_get_data].

Value

If `path` is `NULL`, the raw bytes of the file, with attributes `filename`, `content_type` and `status`. Otherwise, invisibly, a list with the `path` of the saved file, `filename`, `size` in bytes, `content_type` and `status`. If the server holds several versions of `filename` and none could be chosen, a data.table with the versions.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dlw_download_file("WLD", "WLD_2026_ALL_V02_M_V01_A_GMI_INE.do",
                  year = 2026, path = tempdir())
} # }
